limits: Every security finding, CVSS value, coverage state and retest in the scenario is invented.
Changing UI/report presentation language does not translate authored Spanish prose.
Flask test-client acceptance is API-handler acceptance, not a browser or HTTP-server claim.
A native LibreOffice preview does not establish Microsoft Word pagination.
PDF privacy inspection remains partial and heuristic; no OCR, embedded-file opening or action execution is claimed.
Plans and repeated combinations are not additional unique regression identities.
No universal absence of bugs or dead code is inferred from bounded audit evidence.
